title: Story premise EDU073: The Habitat Islands Need a Crossing
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: A green line joins the patches. Can this animal use it? Takeaway/theme: Connectivity depends on the needs of the organism and the quality of the route.
description: An animal icon wants to reach another suitable habitat patch, but development separates the patches in a toy landscape. Comparing possible connections shows why the value of a corridor depends on the species and surrounding conditions.
